feature_funnel.note: the ecosystem-proxy pre-filter is an a priori exclusion of attributes constant within one ecosystem; the data-driven reduction is admissible -> selected, not point_in_time -> selected

canonical_fit.note: single canonical fit used in every table; the previous version fitted the ablation tables with CatBoost defaults (learning_rate=0.1, l2_leaf_reg=3), which is the entire cause of the Table 5 / Table 7 discrepancy

stacking_procedure.meta_inputs: out-of-fold P(malicious) of CatBoost and RandomForest

operational_threshold.fallback: minimise alerts/10k among thresholds satisfying constraint 1; if none satisfies constraint 1, take the maximum-recall threshold

rule_of_three_group_level.bound_rule: rule of three (3/n) when no group is flagged, otherwise the one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson upper bound; numerator AND denominator both counted in GROUPS
rule_of_three_group_level.note: rule of three over INDEPENDENT BENIGN GROUPS, not benign versions

operational_threshold.note_on_prevalence_table: publish the GROUP-level table: the version-level bound (3/n_benign_versions) treats correlated versions as independent trials

calibration.caveat: Brier and ECE are computed under the sampled, class-weighted distribution of the test partition; they do not establish calibration at registry prevalence

ecosystem_confound.reporting_note: report as a descriptive property of the pooled sample. Do NOT write that a percentage of discrimination is 'attributable' to ecosystem identity: a ratio of two AUC-ROC differences is not a decomposition. Do NOT describe the pooled result as an upper bound or the transfer result as a lower bound.

primary_npm.note_on_prefilter: single ecosystem: eco_proxy_features returns an empty list by construction, so the candidate space is the full point-in-time space and the reduction IS data-driven

threshold.fallback: minimise alerts/10k among thresholds satisfying constraint 1; if none satisfies constraint 1, take the maximum-recall threshold

block2_fixed_test_partition.config: F0 selection on the full dataset + current-state attributes
F1 selection restricted to the training partition
F3 + ecosystem proxies removed (= pooled protocol B)

leakage_decomposition.caveat: the two blocks rest on different bases and their deltas are NOT additive; no additive decomposition of the aggregate difference is claimed. Describe the 5.9-point figure as the aggregate difference between two evaluation protocols, and report each factor with its own controlled comparison.

npm->pypi.note: feature selection AND hyperparameter tuning performed exclusively within the source ecosystem; the previous version reused the pooled selection, so target-ecosystem labels had influenced the feature set

pypi->npm.note: feature selection AND hyperparameter tuning performed exclusively within the source ecosystem; the previous version reused the pooled selection, so target-ecosystem labels had influenced the feature set

out_of_time.caveat: class composition differs sharply on either side of the cutoff; this test measures a change in sample composition rather than temporal drift. Similar AUC-ROC in the two transfer directions does NOT establish a structural rather than sampling origin for the degradation.

specification.tie_handling: first eligible candidate in dataset order; this is a deterministic rule, NOT a nearest-neighbour criterion
specification.composite_groups: preserved: the matched sample is split with GroupShuffleSplit on the same composite group_id

evasion.method: all features derived from one source field are copied jointly from a single presumed-benign donor drawn from the TRAINING partition, so the resulting vector is producible by a valid manifest; release-history features are not manipulable without actually publishing versions and are held fixed

curve.fields: description, keywords, repository, license, version, name
description, keywords, repository, license, version, name, dependencies
description, keywords, repository, license, version, name, dependencies, author

ablations.note: budgets, orderings, families, stage ablations and selector comparisons are estimated on the validation partition; a single locked configuration is evaluated once on the test partition, in section 15

table.ordering: mi -> variance -> boruta -> corr -> rfe -> budget
variance -> mi -> boruta -> rfe -> corr -> budget
boruta -> variance -> mi -> rfe -> corr -> budget
corr -> variance -> mi -> boruta -> rfe -> budget

variance -> mi -> corr -> boruta -> rfe -> budget

table.selector: Random 18 of 40 (matched candidate space), median of 200 draws

matched_budget.reporting_note: report the observed difference and the cluster-bootstrap interval width side by side. Do NOT write 'equivalence' or 'no measurable advantage' without a clustered paired non-inferiority test with a pre-declared margin.

label_noise_10pct.definition: 10% of TRAINING labels inverted uniformly at random

feature_corruption_20pct.definition: 20% of TEST values replaced by draws from the training marginal of the same attribute

protocol.note: median and IQR reported; hardware stated in Section 2.5
